Thanks for flagging. Policy overview: promotional trial credits issued automatically during PLG signup are normally tied to the workspace created at the moment of sign-up. We can perform a one-time manual reassignment when the same legal account (account id GW-ACCT-211) owns both workspaces and there is no evidence of abuse. Requirements: (1) confirmation of account ownership, (2) timestamped receipt or signup token, (3) a brief note from the customer authorizing the move.

I can approve a manual reassign of $500 credited on 2026-04-17T22:41:00Z from greenwave-legacy-01 -> ws-GW-02 pending Aditya's confirmation of ledger availability. If approved I will create a billing adjustment record and provide a transaction reference and the new credit balance.

Aditya — can you check the ledger and confirm we have $500 in promotional credits available to reassign and that this won’t impact any reserved promotions?
